title: pickTrackerModel
responsibility: Route media deliverables to Claude Sonnet 5.5 and select the earliest eligible Tracker model for other work using valid pins and measured outcomes.

inputs.name: pickTrackerMediaModel.item
inputs.description: Tracker title and notes that may request a media deliverable.

inputs.name: pickTrackerModel.item
inputs.description: Tracker item with its text, optional model pin and eligibility information.

inputs.name: pickTrackerModel.options
inputs.description: Optional ladder configuration and outcomes from similar prior work.

inputs.name: retryTrackerModel.item
inputs.description: Tracker item to use when selecting a retry model.

inputs.name: retryTrackerModel.run
inputs.description: Previous attempt's model, effort, ladder position and pin status.

inputs.name: retryTrackerModel.cfg
inputs.description: Optional configuration for the current model ladder and eligibility rules.

outputs.name: pickTrackerModel
outputs.description: Selected model and effort with the work type and reason for the choice.

outputs.name: retryTrackerModel
outputs.description: Sonnet for a media deliverable, or the existing pinned or escalated model for other work.

inputs.name: pickTrackerMediaModel.item
inputs.description: Tracker title and notes that may request a media deliverable.

outputs.name: pickTrackerMediaModel
outputs.description: The fixed Sonnet selection for a media deliverable, or null for normal routing.
